description: This Java class defines a REST endpoint for managing Employee entities via HTTP requests. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employees, utilizing Spring MVC annotations and dependency injection.

classes.name: EmployeeRestEndpoint
classes.description: REST controller for employee-related operations, exposing endpoints for CRUD operations on Employee resources.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve employee details by ID, returning an EmployeeResource wrapped in ResponseEntity.

methods.name: createEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new employee from the provided EmployeeResource.

methods.name: updateExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing employee with data from EmployeeResource.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an employee by ID.
